  MEETING OF THE
  LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, OCTOBER 23, 2023 AT 8:00 AM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

T he City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Library
Board of Trustees with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 4th Monday of every month at 8:00 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the Community Services Department via email at
KShigenaga@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at (626) 300­0791 at least 48 hours prior to
the meeting.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do its best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
Visit www.CityofSanMarino.org/Zoom.

How to offer public comment from home:
  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to KShigenaga@CityofSanMarino.org until
  7:00 a.m. the day of the meeting, to be read during public comment. Lengthy public
  comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments received after 7:00
  a.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the meeting.
  2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in­person comments.

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.CityofSanMarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Library Board of
Trustees on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Board of
Trustees. Pursuant to state law, the Library Board of Trustees may not discuss or take
action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Chair
reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up
on such items.

MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, OCTOBER 23, 2023 AT 8:00 A.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Trustee Osegueda called the regular meeting to order at 8:06 a.m. in the Barth
Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Trustee Osegueda led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Wahl, Alternate Wu, Trustee Chien, Trustee Osegueda

  ABSENT: Trustee Derry, Vice Chairperson Sadun, Chairperson Domier

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

1. CHAIRPERSON REPORT

No report was given.

2. TRUSTEE REPORTS

Trustee Osegueda shared that she is super excited about the collaboration program between the
Crowell Public Library and Carver Library. She added that the art teacher is getting involved with
the collaboration to acquire reference books that she doesn’t have the budget for. She also shared
that Mrs. Morris, a prior librarian for over 30 years at Carver Library, passed away last week and
there will be a celebration of life on November 18 at 10 AM at the Community Church.

Alternate Wahl, Alternate Wu, and Trustee Chien did not have anything to report.

3. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

No report was given.

4. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
No report was given.

5. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
No report was given.
